The focus order for navigation elements is not logical. Sub-menu items (e.g., "За општината", "Организација") appear after all top-level navigation items, rather than immediately following their respective parent menu items. This makes the navigation structure unpredictable and difficult to operate for keyboard users, violating the principle of predictable focus order.
items.suggestion: Ensure all interactive elements (links, buttons) have clear and descriptive accessible names (e.g., using `aria-label`, `alt` text for images, or visible text content). Implement a logical and predictable focus order for navigation menus: when a parent menu item receives focus and opens a sub-menu, all sub-menu items should be focusable immediately after their parent before moving to the next top-level menu item. This often involves using `aria-haspopup` and managing `tabindex` for dropdowns or fly-out menus.
